disclaimer: This is a planning outline and cost estimate only. It is not legal, tax, or regulatory advice. Hire an appropriate licensed professional for compliance matters.

steps.title: Start with a logo and brand identity
steps.why: For almost any small business, brand work is the sensible first hire. A consistent logo and look makes every later step easier and avoids re-work.

steps.title: Hire a photographer for product or premises photos
steps.why: Photo quality is the base asset reused everywhere online, so it comes early.

steps.title: Hire a social media manager for Facebook and Instagram
steps.why: Most Myanmar customers are on Facebook, so regular posting under a monthly plan is where visibility starts.

steps.title: Add a basic website when things settle
steps.why: Once the business is steady, a simple site helps customers find and trust you beyond social channels.
